parameters.name: BackupId
parameters.description: The ID of the backup file.

parameters.name: BackupJobId
parameters.description: The ID of the backup job returned by the `CreateBackup` operation. If `CreateBackup` returns multiple backup job IDs, call this operation for each ID.

parameters.name: EndTime
parameters.description: The end time for the query. The end time must be later than the start time. Specify the time in UTC using the *yyyy-MM-dd*T*HH:mm*Z format.

parameters.name: NeedAof
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to enable AOF persistence. Valid values:

- **0**: Disabled.

- **1**: Enabled.

> The default value is **0**.

parameters.name: PageNumber
parameters.description: The page number to return. The value must be greater than **0**. The default value is **1**.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The maximum number of entries to return per page. Valid values: `30`, `50`, `100`, `200`, and `300`.

parameters.name: StartTime
parameters.description: The start time for the query. Specify the time in UTC using the *yyyy-MM-dd*T*HH:mm*Z format.
